limitations: Purpose semantic judgments were adjudicated in P5 (05_dispositions.json) and not persisted to 06_world/world.sqlite per P6 admission policy; derivations compile those dispositions against world relations rather than re-deriving semantic frontier tuples inside TaskView.
evidenced_operational_context has zero persisted tuples (28 obligations UNRESOLVED in P5); Purpose B conditional evaluation cannot draw on operational context enrichment.
Permit PDF prose beyond structured CSV fields is not compiled; schedule activation and event-condition resolution remain limited.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Select at most one enforceable numeric limit per in-scope measurement from structural candidates, or route to explicit unresolved when conditional triggers, competing limits, or permit evidence gaps block binding.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is fy2025_in_scope_measurement (COMPLETE over dmr_measurement_assertion). One obligation per measurement drawn from measurement_limit_structural_candidate.
derivations.required_premise: P5 adjudicated disposition in 05_dispositions.json for relation limit_applicability_judgment keyed by measurement referent.
derivations.optional_enrichment: limit_set_record.conditional_comment and evidenced_operational_context inform conditional applicability; enrichment is optional because ACCEPT may proceed on DMR LIMIT_VALUE_ID linkage alone.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Classify whether a measurement/limit pair is subject to enforceable numeric comparison, report-only monitoring, or non-comparable reporting based on limit enforceability flags and DMR value shape.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is fy2025_in_scope_measurement. Evaluated after limit applicability is considered for each measurement.
derivations.required_premise: P5 adjudicated disposition in 05_dispositions.json for relation numeric_comparison_regime_judgment keyed by measurement referent.
derivations.optional_enrichment: Accepted limit_applicability_judgment tuple supplies applicable_limit for regime classification when limit linkage is established.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Compare reported numeric measurement to established applicable enforceable limit using limit qualifier semantics; emit exceeds or does_not_exceed only when comparison prerequisites are met.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Candidate universe is measurements with ACCEPT limit_applicability_judgment and enforceable_numeric_comparison regime; non-numeric measurements are out of scope for exceedance derivation.
derivations.required_premise: P5 adjudicated disposition in 05_dispositions.json for relation exceedance_judgment keyed by (measurement, applicable_limit); mechanical comparison uses reported_value_nmbr, limit_value_nmbr, and limit_value_qualifier from world relations.
derivations.optional_enrichment: numeric_comparison_regime_judgment ACCEPT:enforceable_numeric_comparison is required premise for emitting exceedance outcome; without it, exceedance is omitted rather than inferred.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Partition all FY2025 in-scope measurements into rows (established applicability and/or comparison regime) or unresolved (applicability or unit-comparison blockers). Preserve uncertainty; do not default limit or compliance outcomes.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: rows plus unresolved account for every tuple in fy2025_in_scope_measurement (824 expected).
derivations.required_premise: Compiled P5 dispositions for limit_applicability_judgment, numeric_comparison_regime_judgment, and exceedance_judgment joined to world registries.
derivations.optional_enrichment: limit_set_record conditional_comment carried in unresolved rationale grounding only.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Three-valued applicability (required, not_required, conditional_resolved) for each FY2025 monitoring requirement; unresolved when conditional triggers or schedule activation cannot be established from evidence.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is fy2025_monitoring_requirement (COMPLETE over limit_set_record). One obligation per monitoring_requirement referent for FY2025 applicability period.
derivations.required_premise: P5 adjudicated disposition in 05_dispositions.json for relation monitoring_requirement_applicability_judgment keyed by monitoring_requirement referent.
derivations.optional_enrichment: evidenced_operational_context for discharge-occurrence and event triggers; dmr_measurement_assertion does not establish non-requirement by absence alone.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Emit rows for requirements with established applicability outcomes; unresolved for requirements whose FY2025 applicability cannot be determined.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: rows plus unresolved account for every tuple in fy2025_monitoring_requirement (6 expected).
derivations.required_premise: Compiled P5 dispositions for monitoring_requirement_applicability_judgment joined to limit_set_record and registries.
derivations.optional_enrichment: evidenced_operational_context would resolve conditional triggers when populated; currently empty in world.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Assign exactly one Purpose C taxonomy state when positive evidence supports it; never infer compliance or violation from missing numeric data alone.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: Universe is monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result (COMPLETE over fy2025_in_scope_measurement anti-join measurement_has_numeric_result).
derivations.required_premise: P5 adjudicated disposition in 05_dispositions.json for relation missing_evidence_semantic_judgment keyed by monitoring_expectation referent.
derivations.optional_enrichment: monitoring_requirement_applicability_judgment for cross-purpose consistency on non-requirement states; evidenced_operational_context for documented no-discharge.

derivations.epistemic_behavior: Partition all FY2025 no-result monitoring expectations into rows with established semantic states or unresolved when NODI/operational evidence is insufficient.
derivations.completeness_assumptions: rows plus unresolved account for every tuple in monitoring_expectation_without_numeric_result (186 expected).
